harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed a demo app on node2:8080 (Python http.server, systemd-managed), isolated it via iptables so only node1's IP may reach port 8080 (all other sources DROPed), and stood up a WireGuard tunnel terminated on node1 (wg0, UDP 51820, NAT-masquerading tunnel traffic out eth0) with node3 as the sole client (wg0 10.200.0.0/24, AllowedIPs restricted to node2's address). Verified node3 can reach node2:8080 only when the tunnel is up, and gets no response when it's down. Completed the mandatory node-restart protocol on all three nodes (node1 VyOS, node2, node3 Ubuntu 16.04), one at a time, each showing a changed OS boot_id and full recovery of WireGuard, firewall rules, and the demo app afterward.
actions_performed: Inspected network topology and OS on node1/node2/node3
Installed wireguard/wireguard-tools kernel module on node3 (Ubuntu 16.04, kernel 4.4)
Generated WireGuard keypairs on node1 (VyOS PKI) and node3
Configured VyOS wg0 interface + peer + NAT source masquerade rule on node1, committed and saved
Configured wg-quick wg0 on node3 as client with AllowedIPs restricted to node2's address, enabled at boot
Deployed demo-app.service (python3 http.server on port 8080) on node2, enabled at boot
Configured iptables INPUT rules on node2 restricting tcp/8080 to node1's IP only (all else DROP), persisted via iptables-save + iptables-restore.service
Verified node3 can reach node2:8080 only via the tunnel (direct access fails when wg0 is down)
Captured baseline boot_id on all 3 nodes
Restarted node1, node2, node3 sequentially via native reboot, polled until exec available, confirmed boot_id changed each time
Re-verified WireGuard tunnel, iptables isolation, and app health after each node's restart

evidence.requirement: App served from node2 on TCP 8080
evidence.summary: demo-app.service started and active, serving on port 8080

evidence.requirement: WireGuard tunnel terminated on node1, node3 as client
evidence.summary: wg0 configured on node1 (VyOS) with peer node3; wg-quick up on node3 establishes handshake

evidence.requirement: node3 reaches node2:8080 only through the tunnel
evidence.summary: Direct access from node3 to 10.100.224.11:8080 fails (http_code=000) with wg0 down; succeeds immediately once wg0 is up

evidence.requirement: node2 firewall restricts port 8080 to only the tunnel/gateway path (node1)
evidence.summary: iptables rule set: ACCEPT from 10.100.224.10 only, DROP all other sources on tcp/8080, correctly ordered

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: boot_id 7668189d -> ed9ce6dd after reboot; wg0 auto-restored with correct config; tunnel data path re-verified end to end

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: boot_id dca72801 -> 08f9226c after reboot; demo-app.service and iptables-restore.service both active post-boot; tunnel-only access re-verified

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: boot_id 74fd91b6 -> 4fd06daf after reboot; wg-quick@wg0 auto-started, handshake re-established, curl to app succeeded
